newsitem.title: LATVIA: OFF BOURSE TRADE BEATS MARKET IN JUNE FIRST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: OFF BOURSE TRADE BEATS MARKET IN JUNE FIRST WEEK.

text.p: Trade off the bourse was higher than it was on the bourse during the first week of June, the stock exchange said on Monday.
Off-bourse trade for the week of June 2 to June 6 was 336,373 lats versus 283,827 lats on the stock market in central market trade, the bourse said in a statement.

The most traded share off the bourse was confectioner Staburadze with 250,470 lats of turnover followed by Riga Transport Fleet on trade of 26,050 lats and then Lode on 28,200 lats of off-bourse trade.
